interpretation.state_energy: Reproducibility budget for the same 40 Ry/DZP model, not a complete-basis error.
interpretation.energy_gap: Protects the relative diabatic surface separation from a common total-energy shift.
interpretation.coupling: Applies to the orthogonalized linearized FDE-FODFT coupling.
interpretation.phase: One common determinant phase is aligned before comparing overlap, H12, and coupling because an occupied-orbital sign change flips all three without changing the diabatic physics.
interpretation.cutoff_scan: A 60 Ry comparison quantifies model discretization and is reported before this budget is tightened.
